name: Герои Эхо недели зверей — курганный народ, отбивший нашествие Орды Златого Оленя «Великий перегон» (ADR-0023, ADR-0024; docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Звери — Орда Златого Оленя»; RS.weeks в design/ui/roster.js). Пятеро по герою за цикл II–VI: c2-47 Таргым Курган, c3-52 Кезы Арканщица, c4-52 Анахе Костоправка, c5-58 Ойсу Лучник Кургана, c6-52 Бурте Секач. Задание 30.09.2026: портреты для окон призыва и Эхо вместо инициалов. Рецепт — принятый отряд Иш-Кантуна (jobs/heroes-echo-ishkantun.json) и способ «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md); в рамке добавлено, что нижний край режет фигуру по поясу (Ашнун недели людей дважды вышел в полный рост). Раса — Забытые, облик ни на кого из нынешних не похож. Курганный народ — решение агента по главам: высокие, ширококостные, длинноголовые, глаза бледного янтаря, кожа цвета сухой степной земли, у всех одна тяжёлая коса и бронзовый обруч; войлок, овчина, кость, рог, бронза, волосяной аркан; курганы над мёртвыми. Враги недели — разумные звери Орды в золоте (jobs/echo-goldendeer.json) — только трофеи и угроза за правым краем. Класс — по оружию и действию, школа — по цвету света. Детали, которых нет в «кто он» и главах, — решение агента, по строке в source
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, heroic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no glyphs, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; no empty eyes. The hero is a person, not a beast: no antlers, no horns and no animal head on the hero; no riders.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame, whatever the pose. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they are; the pose carries weight and intent. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size, with a clear expression; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there, but nothing is written there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

The hero belongs to the kurgan people — a forgotten people who lived long before all the peoples of today on the endless steppe of feather grass, and raised great grassy mounds, kurgans, over their dead so that the steppe would know where they lie. They look unlike any people living now: tall, heavy-boned and broad in the shoulder, with long heads, strong jaws, heavy brows and deep-set eyes of pale amber; their skin is weathered grey-bronze, like dry steppe earth; men and women alike wear their dark hair in one heavy rope-like braid and a thin band of dull bronze around the brow. They wear long coats and trousers of felt and sheepskin, wide leather belts, toggles of bone and horn and beads of amber; their tools are bronze, horn, bone and braided horsehair. Their enemies were the Horde of the Golden Stag — intelligent beasts of the steppe, great deer, wolves, boars and griffins that spoke like people, their antlers and tusks sheathed in gold, gold plaques with stags and griffins on their chests; they crossed the land in great migrations and trampled everything in their way; such things appear only as trophies or as the threat beyond the right edge.

jobs.title: Таргым Курган — Забытые, танк, Земля (c2-47, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c2-47: «Насыпал курган поперёк пути великого перегона и стоял на нём, пока стадо обходило»; глава «Курган поперёк пути»: курган землёй из-под копыт; стадо обтекло его, как вода камень — могил звери не топчут; кабан-страж оставил ему бок в крови. Решение агента: щит из воловьей кожи против кабана справа; лопата, вбитая в курган; обломок кабаньего клыка в золоте в щите. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c2-47-targym__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-47.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Targym of the Kurgan, a man of the kurgan people, a defender of the Earth school. Who he is: the great migration of the Horde swept over his camp in one morning and carried away everything but the dead. Over them he heaped a kurgan — right across the path, with earth from under the hooves — and stood on it; the second herd flowed around the mound like water around a stone: beasts do not trample graves, though they trample the living. Right now a boar-guard of the Horde charges up the mound at him. Character: grim, grieving and utterly immovable; his jaw set, his brows lowered, his amber eyes steady and full of hatred, fixed on the boar beyond the right edge. Pose, the moment of the charge: the camera is low; he stands on top of the fresh mound, turned toward the right, his shoulders driven forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm braces a great round shield of thick layered bull-hide toward the right against the charge; his far hand grips the handle of a long wooden spade driven into the mound beside him. Amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from cracks in the fresh earth, and clods fly up around the shield. Details that tell his story: (1) the fresh earth on his spade and hands is full of hoof-prints; (2) a long gash along his side is bound with a strip of felt; (3) his hands and forearms are black with earth to the elbows; (4) a broken boar tusk ringed with gold is stuck in the shield; (5) behind him the stampede of the Horde flows past the mound, a river of antlers and dust in soft focus. Place: the night steppe of feather grass under a pale moon, the dust of the migration hanging in the air, a lone standing stone beside the mound. Amber light rises from the cracks in the earth below; cold moonlight on his shoulders.

jobs.title: Кезы Арканщица — Забытые, контроль (на контроль), Воздух (c3-52, Эхо, эпическая)

Без вожака стадо шло мимо»; главы «Аркан» (стадо идёт за тем, у кого рога выше; бляхи звенят, когда вожак поворачивает голову), «Золотые рога» (бросать туда, где зверь будет через вдох; руку вправляли дважды). Решение агента: миг броска — петля из чёрно-белого конского волоса летит вправо, на золотые рога за краем; бубенцы и бляхи с рогов вожаков у пояса; кожаный наруч, обожжённый верёвкой. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c3-52-kezy__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-52.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Kezy the Lasso-Thrower, a woman of the kurgan people, a controller of the Air school. Who she is: with a lasso she took wild aurochs on the steppe, and she knew that a herd follows the one with the highest horns. The leaders of the Horde of the Golden Stag were stags in gold, their antlers hung with gold plaques that ring when they turn their heads; she threw her lasso not at the beast but at where the beast would be in one breath, and pulled the leaders down, and a herd without a leader stood, roared and went past. Right now a golden-antlered leader calls to its herd beyond the right edge, and she throws. Character: bold, cool and deadly precise — a hunter who is always one breath ahead; her eyes narrowed, a grim smile, her whole body a whip. Pose, the moment of the throw: the camera is low; she stands in the feather grass, turned toward the right, her body twisted into the throw. She has exactly two arms: her near arm has just flung the lasso — a wide loop of braided horsehair flies out toward the right, high in the air, about to drop over golden antlers beyond the right edge; her far hand holds the rest of the coiled rope tight against her hip, braced for the jerk. A spiral of pale white-green wind of the Air school carries the loop and flattens the grass. Details that tell her story: (1) the lasso is braided of black and white horsehair, glossy and strong; (2) small gold bells and plaques torn from the antlers of leaders she caught hang from her belt; (3) a leather bracer on her throwing forearm is scorched by the rope; (4) a strip of leather binds her elbow, broken and set twice; (5) her heavy braid swings with the throw. Place: the night steppe during the great migration: a moving sea of antlers, gold glints and dust in soft focus behind her, a kurgan against the moon. Pale white-green light of the Air school rises from the grass below; moonlight on the dust.

jobs.title: Анахе Костоправка — Забытые, лекарь, Вода (c4-52, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c4-52: «Костоправ курганного народа. После перегона вправляла кости и людям, и зверям — тем, что остались и ещё говорили»; главы «Кости после перегона» (выпрямляла Ойсу кривые древки, как кости), «Говорящие звери» (волк прожил у неё зиму), «Тихая степь». Решение агента: миг вправления — шина из кости и мокрый ремень в руках, голубой свет Воды; связки шин и древки стрел за поясом; клок волчьей шерсти в косе — от волка, что зимовал у неё. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c4-52-anahe__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-52.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Anahe the Bonesetter, a woman of the kurgan people, a healer of the Water school. Who she is: after the great migration the steppe lay as if after hail, and bones were broken in everyone who had bones. She set them all winter without rest — for shepherds, children and the old, and also for the wounded beasts of the Horde left behind on the steppe, which still spoke: a bone is a bone, whoever breaks it. She straightened crooked arrow shafts the same way as bones. Right now she sets a broken limb with one hard, sure movement. Character: gruff, strong, fearless and deeply kind; her big hands sure, her brows drawn together, her jaw set, her amber eyes calm and focused. Pose, the moment of setting the bone: the camera is low; she leans forward toward the right over the wounded one beyond the right edge, her shoulders hunched in effort. She has exactly two arms: her near hand reaches toward the right holding a straight splint of pale bone, and a wet leather thong trails from it; her far hand is raised with a roll of wet felt bandage. Cool blue light of the Water school pours from her hands like water, and the wet thong glistens. Details that tell her story: (1) bundles of straight splints of bone and wood hang at her belt; (2) a sheaf of arrow shafts she is straightening is tucked into her belt at the back; (3) her knuckles are big and scarred; (4) a waterskin of felt and leather over her shoulder; (5) a tuft of grey wolf fur is tied at the end of her braid — from a wolf of the Horde that wintered with her. Place: the trampled steppe at a cold dawn after the migration: broken grass, hoof-churned earth, a kurgan and a standing stone in soft focus, frost on the grass. Blue light of the Water school rises from a small stream below; the dawn sky is pale and cold.

jobs.subject: Subject: Oisu, Archer of the Kurgan, a man of the kurgan people, a swift archer of the Air school. Who he is: from the top of Targym's kurgan he could see the whole herd, and the herd could not reach him — beasts do not trample the mound of the dead. He climbed it with a bow and three quivers and shot the griffins of the Horde out of the sky; his arrows were found on the steppe for ages after. Right now a griffin dives at him out of the sky from the right. Character: cold, proud and unrelenting — he has chosen to shoot the herd from above and does not care that the old ones call it unfair; his eyes narrowed along the arrow, his jaw hard. Pose, the moment of the shot: the camera is low; he stands on the top of the kurgan, turned toward the right, leaning back, the bow drawn high toward the upper right. He has exactly two arms: his near arm holds a heavy recurved bow of horn and wood raised toward the upper right; his far hand draws the string back to his ear, the arrow aimed at a griffin beyond the upper right edge. A spiral of pale white-green wind of the Air school winds around the arrow and pulls at his braid. Details that tell his story: (1) three quivers at his back and hip, one of them already empty; (2) his arrow shafts are slightly uneven — crooked shafts straightened by hand; (3) long tawny griffin feathers are tied to his quiver as trophies; (4) deep claw scratches across his leather shoulder guard; (5) below him the grass of the mound and the dust of the herd flowing past. Place: the top of a great kurgan at night under a huge moon; the migration of the Horde a river of antlers and gold in the dust below; the dark shape of spread griffin wings against the moon at the edge of the sky. Pale white-green light of the Air school rises from the grass of the mound below; cold moonlight rims his figure.

jobs.title: Бурте Секач — Забытые, физ ДД силы, Земля (c6-52, Эхо, первородная)

jobs.subject: Subject: Burte the Cleaver, a man of the kurgan people, a warrior of great strength of the Earth school. Who he is: the best axe-fighter of the kurgan people. His axe was forged of bronze traded at the river, and he carved its haft himself from a root that does not split. He hunted the wolves of the Horde along the edges of the herd and never once answered them when they spoke; on the last migration he walked through the herd to meet the Golden Stag itself, and the herd parted before him like before a kurgan. After that meeting the Horde never came again. Right now the Golden Stag towers before him beyond the right edge, and he strikes. Character: silent, massive and implacable — a man who never answers; his mouth shut in a hard line, his heavy brows lowered, his amber eyes cold and unwavering. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he strides toward the right, his torso twisted, his shoulders rolled back. He has exactly two arms: both hands grip the long haft of a great bronze battle-axe and swing it from high over his far shoulder down toward the right in one tremendous blow; the heavy bronze head is large and close to the camera near the top of the picture. Amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from the ground at the moment of the blow; clods and dust fly. Details that tell his story: (1) the axe haft is carved from a gnarled dark root, polished by his hands; (2) a sack of gold plaques with stags, torn from the chests of the Horde's wolves, hangs at his hip; (3) old scars from boar tusks across his forearms; (4) a thick grey-streaked beard, his heavy braid bound with a bronze ring; (5) at the right edge of the picture rises one huge antler sheathed in gold and hung with small gold bells. Place: the heart of the migration at night: a sea of antlers, gold and dust parting around him, the moon above the steppe. Amber light rises from the cracked earth below; gold glints in the dust.
